primitives.name: CubicHermite
primitives.arithmetic: four-sample Catmull-Rom tangent cubic; transcribed as a stateless reusable utility; not used by Model 62 DSP

primitives.name: EmsSvf96
primitives.arithmetic: exact extraction of the approved nonlinear 96 kHz two-integrator filter core; input, routing and resampling remain module-owned

primitives.name: GaloisLfsr
primitives.arithmetic: bit-identical unsigned right-shift XOR Galois step; caller owns nonzero state and clock; supported 7/15/31-bit masks
primitives.validation: N02 1.0.0 archived harness checks exact step parity, exhaustive 7/15-bit periods and algebraic 31-bit period

primitives.name: HybridWaveforms48
primitives.arithmetic: Exact extraction of approved band-limited saw/integral/absolute-sine tables, shaping and signed FM integration helpers; caller owns phase, gain and oversampling
primitives.validation: OSC archived harness compares waveform and helper output bits with embedded implementation

primitives.name: ChorusCore
primitives.arithmetic: Exact extraction of the Dimension-style ensemble and CE-1-style chorus/vibrato shared core; module routing and Voltage controls remain outside the primitive
primitives.validation: CED archived harness compiles the module and primitive, compares module output against this core through stubs, and runs standalone numeric checks

primitives.name: BbdAnalogDelay
primitives.arithmetic: Exact extraction of the mono wet delay path, including control smoothing, BBD clock-linked filtering, Hermite read, compander/grit, feedback, hold compensation and unpatched-tail cap; mixer routing remains caller-owned
primitives.validation: dsp-primitives/tests/validate.py compiles the archived FMC DM-2 core and compares 288000 samples plus reset behavior bit-for-bit

primitives.name: MidpointOversampler2x
primitives.arithmetic: Reusable midpoint interpolation and AVERAGE/SECOND reduction modes; nonlinear laws and processor state remain caller-owned; lightweight approximation, not band-limited resampling
primitives.validation: MidpointOversampler2xTest checks 2x call ordering, both reduction modes, reset, constant input and processor call count
